name: bazar-dor
description: 1. `cp .env.example .env.local` and fill values (MongoDB Atlas URI, secrets, Google/GitHub OAuth keys) 2. `npm i && npm run dev` 3. Deploy on Vercel: set same env vars (BETTER_AUTH_URL / NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL = your Vercel URL). Dynamic routes work on refresh natively. 4. Open the API URL in a browser and, if field names differ, edit `normalize()` in `lib/api.ts`.
